unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces
scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 86-bet): taklif qutisi (Let's / Shall we / Why don't we), quite(+)-very(++)-much(+++)-too(-) shkalasi, John va 6 mehmonxona (A 30, B 50, C 40, D 70, E 95, F 120 funt; u faqat 100 funtga ega) skan bilan mos. Ex.16a dialogdagi 5 bo'shliq (very, too, quite, very, much) mos. Ex.16b rasmlar: Rome pretty(++)/noisy(-), Venice quiet(+)/beautiful(++), Paris beautiful(++)/crowded(-), Nice sunny(+)/exciting(++). Ex.17 Patsy-Bob dialogi 10 bo'shliq va Ex.18 ro'yxati 15 so'z mos. Xato topilmadi.
audioRequiredUz: 16 va 17-mashqlarda 'listen and check' bor, lekin AUDIO KERAK EMAS: har bir bo'shliq yonida kitobning O'ZI belgi (+, ++, +++, -) yoki qavsdagi sifat bergan, va qaysi shakl kerakligi gapning tuzilishidan (than / as ... as / the ... of) ANIQ kelib chiqadi. Har bir javob whyUz da asoslangan.

exercises.instructionEn: To make suggestions we use expressions like: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?
exercises.instructionUz: Taklif qilish uchun quyidagi iboralardan foydalanamiz: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — TAKLIF QILIShNING UCh USULI:

  1)  LET'S + asosiy fe'l
      'LET'S GO to Rome this year.'
      = Kelinglar bu yil Rimga boraylik.
      → TASDIQ gap, savol EMAS.
      → 'Let's' = 'let us' ning qisqargani.

  2)  SHALL WE + asosiy fe'l ... ?
      'SHALL WE GO to Rome this year?'
      = Bu yil Rimga boraylikmi?
      → SAVOL, oxirida savol belgisi.
      → Eng MUlOYIM shakl.

  3)  WHY DON'T WE + asosiy fe'l ... ?
      'WHY DON'T WE GO to Rome this year?'
      = Nega bu yil Rimga bormaymiz?
      → SAVOL shaklida, lekin TAKLIF.
      → So'zma-so'z 'nega ... qilmaymiz', lekin
        ma'nosi 'kel ... qilaylik'.


UCh IBORANING UMUMIY QOIDASI:
  Hammasidan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli keladi
  ('to' YO'Q, '-ing' YO'Q):
     Let's GO       (Let's to go XATO)
     Shall we GO    (Shall we going XATO)
     Why don't we GO


TAKLIFGA JAVOB BERISh:
  ROZI:
     Okay! / OK, let's go.
     That's a good idea.
     Yes, why not?
  ROZI EMAS:
     I'd rather not.
     I don't think so.
     No, let's ... instead.


DIQQAT — 'LET'S' VA 'SHALL WE' FARQI:
  'Let's go.'      — qaror deyarli qabul qilingan
  'Shall we go?'   — fikr so'raladi (muloyimroq)
  'Why don't we go?' — sabab yo'qligini ta'kidlaydi

points.en: Let's go to Rome this year.
points.noteUz:
TASDIQ gap.
'Let's' = 'let us'.
Keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

points.en: Shall we go to Rome this year?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL shaklida — eng muloyim taklif.
'Shall we' + asosiy fe'l.

points.en: Why don't we go to Rome this year?
points.noteUz:
Savol shaklida, lekin TAKLIF ma'nosida.
'Why don't we' + asosiy fe'l.

points.en: Okay! Let's go there then. / That's a good idea.
points.uz: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. / Bu yaxshi fikr.
points.noteUz:
Taklifga ROZI bo'lish javoblari.
16-mashqdagi dialogda ham ishlatilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples and the key language.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI KALIT QUTI — TO'RT KUChAYTIRUVChI:

     QUITE noisy    ( + )     = ancha shovqinli
     VERY noisy     ( ++ )    = juda shovqinli
     MUCH noisiER   ( +++ )   = ancha shovqinliroq
     TOO noisy      ( - )     = haddan tashqari
                                 shovqinli (YOMON)


ENG MUHIM FARQLAR:

  QUITE — o'rtacha daraja ('ancha', 'ancha-muncha')
     Eng ZAIF kuchaytiruvchi.

  VERY — kuchli daraja ('juda')
     'quite' dan kuchliroq.

  MUCH — FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan!
     'much noisIER' TO'G'RI
     'much noisy'   XATO
     Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

  TOO — SALBIY: haddan tashqari, MUAMMO bor
     'too noisy' = shunchalik shovqinliki, chidab
     bo'lmaydi.
     'very noisy' esa shunchaki tasvir.


KITOBDAGI MEHMONXONA MISOLLARI:

  'John has got £100 and wants to spend a weekend
   at a hotel by the sea.'
  (Jonda 100 funt bor va u dengiz bo'yidagi
   mehmonxonada dam olish kunini o'tkazmoqchi.)

     HOTEL A — £30   →  It's VERY cheap.
                        (juda arzon)
     HOTEL B — £50   →  It's QUITE cheap.
                        (ancha arzon)
     HOTEL C — £40   →  It's MUCH CHEAPER than hotel B.
                        (B mehmonxonadan ancha arzonroq)
     HOTEL D — £70   →  It's QUITE expensive.
                        (ancha qimmat)
     HOTEL E — £95   →  It's VERY expensive.
                        (juda qimmat)
     HOTEL F — £120  →  It's TOO expensive.
                        (haddan tashqari qimmat)
                        'He's only got £100.'


NARXLAR NIMANI KO'RSATADI — ENG MUHIM MANTIQ:

  £30 (A)  — eng arzon        → VERY cheap
  £40 (C)  — B dan 10 arzon   → MUCH cheaper THAN B
  £50 (B)  — o'rtacha arzon   → QUITE cheap
  £70 (D)  — biroz qimmat     → QUITE expensive
  £95 (E)  — juda qimmat      → VERY expensive
  £120 (F) — 100 dan OShADI   → TOO expensive

  DIQQAT — 'TOO' NEGA FAQAT F UChUN:
  Jonda faqat £100 bor. £120 — uning PULIDAN
  KO'P, ya'ni u sotib OLA OLMAYDI.
  Shuning uchun 'too'.
  £95 esa qimmat, lekin hali ham MUMKIN → 'very'.

  Bu qoidani ko'rsatadi:
     'TOO' = imkonsiz, muammo bor
     'VERY' = shunchaki yuqori daraja

points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: 'much' FAQAT QIYOSIY daraja bilan.
'much noisy' XATO — 'much noisIER' to'g'ri.

SALBIY — muammo bor, chidab bo'lmaydi.
'very' dan farqi shu.

points.en: John has got £100 and wants to spend a weekend at a hotel by the sea.
points.uz: Jonda 100 funt bor va u dengiz bo'yidagi mehmonxonada dam olish kunini o'tkazmoqchi.
points.noteUz:
£100 — Jonning imkoniyati.
Shu son 'too' ni aniqlaydi.

points.en: HOTEL A costs £30. It's very cheap.
points.uz: A mehmonxona 30 funt turadi. U juda arzon.

points.en: HOTEL B costs £50. It's quite cheap.
points.uz: B mehmonxona 50 funt turadi. U ancha arzon.

points.en: HOTEL C costs £40. It's much cheaper than hotel B.
points.uz: C mehmonxona 40 funt turadi. U B mehmonxonadan ancha arzonroq.
points.noteUz:
IKKI mehmonxona solishtirilmoqda →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'much' + 'cheapER'.

points.en: HOTEL D costs £70. It's quite expensive.
points.uz: D mehmonxona 70 funt turadi. U ancha qimmat.

points.en: HOTEL E costs £95. It's very expensive.
points.uz: E mehmonxona 95 funt turadi. U juda qimmat.
points.noteUz:
Juda qimmat, LEKIN £100 ichida →
hali ham 'very', 'too' emas.

points.en: HOTEL F costs £120. It's too expensive. (He's only got £100.)
points.uz: F mehmonxona 120 funt turadi. U haddan tashqari qimmat. (Unda faqat 100 funt bor.)
points.noteUz:
£120 > £100 → SOTIB OLA OLMAYDI →
'TOO expensive'.
Kitob sababini qavsda O'ZI aytgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then read the dialogue and fill in quite, very, much or too. Listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng dialogni o'qing va quite, very, much yoki too bilan to'ldiring. Tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: Shall we go to Mykonos for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY nice, but I think it's TOO
     expensive for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Santorini then? It's QUITE
     cheap and VERY pretty.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH cheaper than
     Mykonos.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Yozgi ta'tilga Mikonosga boraylikmi?
  B: Ha, u juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha
     biz uchun haddan tashqari qimmat.
  A: Unda nega Santoriniga bormaymiz? U ancha arzon
     va juda go'zal.
  B: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. U Mikonosdan
     ancha arzonroq.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ QANDAY ANIQLANADI —
KITOB BELGINI O'ZI BERGAN:

  1)  (++) nice        →  VERY
  2)  (−)  expensive   →  TOO
  3)  (+)  cheap       →  QUITE
  4)  (++) pretty      →  VERY
  5)  (+++) cheapER    →  MUCH

  Belgilar kalit qutisidan:
     (+) = quite,  (++) = very,
     (+++) = much,  (−) = too


ENG MUHIM TEKShIRUV — 5-BAND:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin 'CHEAPER' (qiyosiy daraja) va
  'THAN Mykonos' turibdi.
  'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatiladi →
  boshqa hech qaysi variant mos kelmaydi.
  Ya'ni belgi bo'lmasa ham, javob ANIQ.

  Qolgan to'rt bandda esa sifat ODDIY shaklda
  ('nice', 'expensive', 'cheap', 'pretty') →
  'much' MUMKIN EMAS.


DIALOGDAGI TAKLIF IBORALARI:
  'SHALL WE go to Mykonos ...?'   (1-usul)
  'WHY DON'T WE go to Santorini?' (2-usul)
  'LET'S go there then.'          (3-usul)
  Kitob uchala usulni ham BITTA dialogda ko'rsatgan.


JOY NOMLARI:
  Mykonos   — Mikonos, Yunonistondagi orol
              (qimmat, mashhur)
  Santorini — Santorini, Yunonistondagi orol
              (arzonroq, go'zal)

lines.textEn: Shall we go to Mykonos for our summer holidays?

lines.whyUz:
(++) → VERY (kalit qutisidan).
'very nice' = juda chiroyli.
DIQQAT: 'nice' ODDIY shaklda → 'much' MUMKIN EMAS.

lines.textEn: ... but I think it's 2) ............ (−) expensive for us.
lines.whyUz:
(−) → TOO.
'too expensive FOR US' = biz uchun haddan tashqari
qimmat, ya'ni SOTIB OLA OLMAYMIZ.
Mehmonxona F misolidagi bilan bir xil mantiq.

lines.textEn: Why don't we go to Santorini then? It's 3) ............ (+) cheap ...
lines.whyUz:
(+) → QUITE.
'quite cheap' = ancha arzon (juda emas).
'Why don't we ...?' — ikkinchi taklif usuli.

(++) → VERY.
'very pretty' = juda go'zal.
1-band bilan bir xil belgi.

lines.textEn: Okay! Let's go there then. It's 5) ............ (+++) cheaper than Mykonos.
lines.whyUz:
(+++) → MUCH.
IKKI DALIL:
  1) belgi (+++) kalit qutisidan
  2) bo'shliqdan keyin 'cheapER ... THAN' —
     QIYOSIY daraja. 'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja
     bilan ishlatiladi.
Shuning uchun bu band belgisiz ham ANIQ.
'Let's go there then' — uchinchi taklif usuli.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in pairs. Use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN TO'RT ShAHAR (rasmlar bilan):

  ITALIYA (ITALY):
     ROME   —  pretty (++),  noisy (−)
     VENICE —  quiet (+),    beautiful (++)

  FRANSIYA (FRANCE):
     PARIS  —  beautiful (++),  crowded (−)
     NICE   —  sunny (+),       exciting (++)

  Rasmlarda:
     Rim    — Treviy fontani (haykallar bilan)
     Venesiya — kanal va gondolalar
     Parij  — Eyfel minorasi va fontanlar
     Nitstsa — dengiz bo'yidagi oq mehmonxona,
               palma daraxtlari


DIALOG QOLIPI (16a dagidek):

  A: Shall we go to [1-shahar] for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks [++] , but I think it's [−] for us.
  A: Why don't we go to [2-shahar] then?
     It's [+] and [++].
  B: Okay! Let's go there then.
     It's much [qiyosiy] than [1-shahar].


IKKI TAYYOR DIALOG:

ITALIYA:
  A: Shall we go to Rome for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY PRETTY, but I think it's
     TOO NOISY for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Venice then? It's QUITE QUIET
     and VERY BEAUTIFUL.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH QUIETER
     than Rome.

FRANSIYA:
  A: Shall we go to Paris for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY BEAUTIFUL, but I think it's
     TOO CROWDED for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Nice then? It's QUITE SUNNY
     and VERY EXCITING.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH SUNNIER
     than Paris.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (ITALIYA):
  A: Yozgi ta'tilga Rimga boraylikmi?
  B: Ha, u juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha
     biz uchun haddan tashqari shovqinli.
  A: Unda nega Venesiyaga bormaymiz? U ancha tinch
     va juda go'zal.
  B: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. U Rimdan
     ancha tinchroq.


DIQQAT — OXIRGI GAPDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJA:
  quiet  → quietER   (bir bo'g'in)
  sunny  → sunnIER   ('-y' → -IER)
  Ikkalasi ham 'much' bilan keladi.

DIQQAT — HAR ShAHARDA BITTA (−) BOR:
  Rome — noisy (−),  Paris — crowded (−)
  Bu KATTA shaharlar, shuning uchun ular
  RAD ETILADI. Venesiya va Nitstsa esa
  tanlanadi — ularda (−) yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Patsy and Bob are trying to choose a hotel to stay at during their holiday. Read the dialogue and fill in the comparative and superlative forms, then listen and check. In pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Petsi va Bob ta'til paytida turish uchun mehmonxona tanlashmoqchi. Dialogni o'qing va qiyosiy hamda orttirma daraja shakllarini to'ldiring, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MEHMONXONA HAQIDA SUHBAT:
  THE SUNSET  — qulay, arzonroq, lekin bosh yo'lda
                (shovqinli)
  THE SEAVIEW — eng arzon, tinchroq, lekin
                iflosroq; xodimlari eng do'stona
  THE GRAND   — eng hashamatli, plyajga eng yaqin,
                lekin juda qimmat


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Bob:   What are you doing, Patsy?
  Patsy: I'm looking at the holiday brochure again.
         There are three hotels in the town, but I
         can't decide which one we should stay at.
  Bob:   Let me see. Hmm ... why don't we stay at the
         Sunset? It looks the MOST COMFORTABLE of the
         three, and it's not as EXPENSIVE as the Grand.
  Patsy: That's true, but it's on the main road, next
         to all the discos and cafes.
  Bob:   So? That means it's in the MOST CONVENIENT
         part of town.
  Patsy: But I'm sure it's much NOISIER than the other
         hotels.
  Bob:   What about the Seaview, then?
  Patsy: Well, it is the CHEAPEST hotel in town, and
         it's probably QUIETER than the Sunset.
  Bob:   Shall we stay at the Seaview, then?
  Patsy: I don't know. It looks quite dirty, don't you
         think?
  Bob:   Perhaps it's not as CLEAN as the others, but
         the brochure says it's got the "FRIENDLIEST
         staff in town."
  Patsy: I like the Grand. It's the MOST LUXURIOUS of
         the three hotels, and it's the CLOSEST to the
         beach.
  Bob:   But it's too expensive! We can't afford it,
         Patsy!
  Patsy: Oh, I suppose you're right. Okay, let's stay
         at the Seaview. I'm sure it will be fine ...


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Bob:   Nima qilyapsan, Petsi?
  Petsi: Yana ta'til bukletiga qarayapman. Shaharda
         uchta mehmonxona bor, lekin qaysi birida
         turishimiz kerakligini hal qila olmayapman.
  Bob:   Qani ko'ray-chi. Hmm ... nega 'Sunset' da
         turmaymiz? U uchtasining eng qulayiga
         o'xshaydi, va 'Grand'chalik qimmat emas.
  Petsi: To'g'ri, lekin u bosh yo'lda, hamma disko va
         kafelarning yonida.
  Bob:   Xo'sh? Demak, u shaharning eng qulay
         qismida joylashgan.
  Petsi: Lekin ishonchim komilki, u boshqa
         mehmonxonalardan ancha shovqinliroq.
  Bob:   Unda 'Seaview' chi?
  Petsi: Ha, u shahardagi eng arzon mehmonxona, va
         ehtimol 'Sunset' dan tinchroq.
  Bob:   Unda 'Seaview' da turaylikmi?
  Petsi: Bilmadim. U ancha iflos ko'rinadi, shunday
         emasmi?
  Bob:   Ehtimol u boshqalarchalik toza emasdir,
         lekin bukletda 'shahardagi eng do'stona
         xodimlar' deyilgan.
  Petsi: Menga 'Grand' yoqadi. U uchta mehmonxonaning
         eng hashamatlisi, va plyajga eng yaqini.
  Bob:   Lekin u haddan tashqari qimmat! Bizning
         imkonimiz yetmaydi, Petsi!
  Petsi: Ha, sen haqsan shekilli. Mayli, 'Seaview' da
         turaylik. Ishonamanki, yaxshi bo'ladi ...


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1)  'the ...... OF THE THREE'
      → 'the ... of' = ORTTIRMA daraja (3 narsa).
      comfortable — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST COMFORTABLE

  2)  'not as ...... AS the Grand'
      → 'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl!
      → EXPENSIVE ('more expensive' XATO)

  3)  'in the ...... PART of town'
      → 'the ...' = ORTTIRMA.
      convenient — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST CONVENIENT

  4)  'much ...... THAN the other hotels'
      → 'much' + 'than' = QIYOSIY daraja.
      noisy — '-y' → NOISIER

  5)  'the ...... HOTEL IN TOWN'
      → 'the ... in' = ORTTIRMA.
      cheap — 1 bo'g'in → THE CHEAPEST

  6)  'probably ...... THAN the Sunset'
      → 'than' = QIYOSIY daraja.
      quiet — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER

  7)  'not as ...... AS the others'
      → 'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl!
      → CLEAN ('cleaner' XATO)

  8)  'the "...... STAFF IN TOWN"'
      → 'the ... in' = ORTTIRMA.
      friendly — '-y' → THE FRIENDLIEST

  9)  'the ...... OF THE THREE hotels'
      → ORTTIRMA (3 narsa).
      luxurious — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS

 10)  'it's the ...... TO THE BEACH'
      → 'the ...' = ORTTIRMA.
      close — '-e' → THE CLOSEST


ENG MUHIM DARS — 2 va 7-BANDLAR ALDAMChI:
  Mashq nomi 'qiyosiy va orttirma shakllarni
  to'ldiring' bo'lsa ham, bu ikki bandda
  sifatning ODDIY shakli kerak —
  chunki 'as ... as' qolipi ishlatilgan.
     'not as EXPENSIVE as'  ✓
     'not as more expensive as'  ✗
     'not as CLEAN as'  ✓
     'not as cleaner as'  ✗


QANDAY ANIQLASh — UCh KALIT SO'Z:
     THAN    bor  →  QIYOSIY daraja
     THE ... OF/IN →  ORTTIRMA daraja
     AS ... AS     →  ODDIY shakl


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a brochure   = buklet, reklama kitobchasi
  to decide    = hal qilmoq
  convenient   = qulay (joylashuv haqida)
  staff        = xodimlar (KO'PLIK ma'nosida)
  luxurious    = hashamatli
  to afford    = imkoni yetmoq
  I suppose    = menimcha, shekilli
  probably     = ehtimol
  perhaps      = ehtimol, balki

lines.textEn: What are you doing, Patsy?
I'm looking at the holiday brochure again. There are three hotels in the town, but I can't decide which one we should stay at.
Let me see. Hmm ... why don't we stay at the Sunset? It looks the 1) ............ (comfortable) of the three, ...
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'the ... OF the three'.
Uchta mehmonxonadan ENG qulayi.
'comfortable' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST COMFORTABLE.
'comfortablest' XATO.

lines.textEn: ... and it's not as 2) ............ (expensive) as the Grand.
lines.whyUz:
ODDIY ShAKL — 'as ... as' qolipi.
'not as EXPENSIVE as' ✓
'not as more expensive as' ✗
BU BAND ALDAMChI: mashq 'qiyosiy va orttirma
shakllarni to'ldiring' desa ham, bu yerda
sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.

lines.textEn: That's true, but it's on the main road, next to all the discos and cafes.
So? That means it's in the 3) ............ (convenient) part of town.
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'in THE ... part of town'.
'convenient' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST CONVENIENT.
'convenient' = qulay (joylashuv haqida).
Bob kamchilikni AFZALLIKKA aylantirmoqda.

lines.textEn: But I'm sure it's much 4) ............ (noisy) than the other hotels.
lines.whyUz:
QIYOSIY daraja: 'much ... THAN'.
'noisy' — '-y' bilan tugagan → NOISIER.
DIQQAT: 'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan
(16-mashqdagi kalit qutisi).

lines.textEn: What about the Seaview, then?
Well, it is the 5) ............ (cheap) hotel in town, ...
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'THE ... hotel IN town'.
'cheap' — 1 bo'g'in → THE CHEAPEST.

lines.textEn: ... and it's probably 6) ............ (quiet) than the Sunset.
lines.whyUz:
QIYOSIY daraja: 'THAN' bor.
'quiet' — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER.
'probably' = ehtimol (aniq emasligini bildiradi).

lines.textEn: Shall we stay at the Seaview, then?
I don't know. It looks quite dirty, don't you think?
Perhaps it's not as 7) ............ (clean) as the others, ...
lines.whyUz:
ODDIY ShAKL — 'as ... as' qolipi.
'not as CLEAN as' ✓
'not as cleaner as' ✗
2-band bilan bir xil qoida.
Bu — mashqning ENG MUHIM darsi.

lines.textEn: ... but the brochure says it's got the "8) ............ (friendly) staff in town."
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'THE ... staff IN town'.
'friendly' — '-y' bilan tugagan → THE FRIENDLIEST.
DIQQAT: 'friendly' '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT,
ravish emas.
'staff' = xodimlar (ko'plik ma'nosida, lekin
fe'l birlikda: 'it's GOT').

lines.textEn: I like the Grand. It's the 9) ............ (luxurious) of the three hotels, ...
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'the ... OF the three hotels'.
'luxurious' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS.
'luxurious' = hashamatli.

lines.textEn: ... and it's the 10) ............ (close) to the beach.
lines.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'it's THE ... to the beach'.
'close' — '-e' bilan tugagan → faqat -ST →
THE CLOSEST.
'closeest' XATO.
84-betdagi 7-mashqda sinonimi berilgan: 'near'.

lines.textEn: But it's too expensive! We can't afford it, Patsy!
Oh, I suppose you're right. Okay, let's stay at the Seaview. I'm sure it will be fine ...

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang va gaplar tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN QOIDASI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan bitta so'z tanlanadi
  • O'sha so'z bilan TO'G'RI gap tuziladi
  • Har bir to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib

RO'YXAT TUZILIShI — DIQQAT:

  ODDIY SIFATLAR (5 ta):
     clean, interesting, delicious, crowded
     (+ 'sunny weather' ichidagi 'sunny')

  QIYOSIY DARAJADA BERILGANLAR (4 ta):
     quieter, more polluted, noisier, more expensive
     → bularni THAN bilan ishlatish kerak

  ORTTIRMA DARAJADA BERILGAN (1 ta):
     oldest
     → 'THE oldest ... IN/OF' bilan ishlatish kerak

  OT BIRIKMALARI (5 ta):
     street performers, designer clothes, nightlife,
     sunny weather, heavy traffic, fashionable clothes

  HAMMASI Unit 12 ning 82-86-betlaridan.


NAMUNA GAPLAR — HAR BIR SO'Z UChUN:

patterns.formula: Shall we + asosiy fe'l ... ?   /   Why don't we + asosiy fe'l ... ?   /   Let's + asosiy fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Shall we go to Mykonos? Why don't we go to Santorini then? Okay! Let's go there then.
patterns.exampleUz: Mikonosga boraylikmi? Unda nega Santoriniga bormaymiz? Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik.
patterns.explanationUz:
Taklif qilishning uch usuli.
Hammasidan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
('to' yo'q, '-ing' yo'q).

patterns.formula: It's VERY / QUITE / TOO + oddiy sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: It looks very nice, but I think it's too expensive for us. It's quite cheap and very pretty.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha biz uchun haddan tashqari qimmat. U ancha arzon va juda go'zal.
patterns.explanationUz:
quite (+) < very (++), too (−) esa SALBIY —
muammo borligini bildiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: It's much cheaper than Mykonos. It's much noisier than the other hotels.
patterns.exampleUz: U Mikonosdan ancha arzonroq. U boshqa mehmonxonalardan ancha shovqinliroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan.
'much cheap' XATO.

patterns.formula: It's THE + ORTTIRMA + OF THE THREE / IN TOWN.
patterns.exampleEn: It looks the most comfortable of the three. It is the cheapest hotel in town.
patterns.exampleUz: U uchtasining eng qulayiga o'xshaydi. U shahardagi eng arzon mehmonxona.
patterns.explanationUz:
'the ... OF' yoki 'the ... IN' —
ORTTIRMA daraja belgisi.

patterns.formula: It's NOT AS + ODDIY sifat + AS ... .
patterns.exampleEn: It's not as expensive as the Grand. Perhaps it's not as clean as the others.
patterns.exampleUz: U 'Grand'chalik qimmat emas. Ehtimol u boshqalarchalik toza emasdir.
patterns.explanationUz:
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
'not as more expensive as' XATO.
Bu — 17-mashqning eng muhim darsi.
